predictions.P2: M-code (PRIMARY frame, R1 readout) and M-desc: landing verdict for the 15 survivors (15 x unit Dijkstra) = EDGE at the committed block, with class(dijkstra_unit) = EDGE at both k 10 and 15
predictions.P3: M-name and M-lex: verdict OPPOSITE (class(dijkstra_unit) = OPPOSITE at k 10 and 15)
predictions.P4: M-name alias level: Spearman(g_alias, L1) <= -0.6 at k 10 AND k 15 (15 alias point sets of NB5)
predictions.P5: M-code and M-desc: the overlap ordering does not reproduce (descriptive)
predictions.P6: behavioural RDM: dijkstra_unit has the smallest d_beh to BFS among NB5 (anchor; true by construction for the order term)
predictions.P7: RSA (descriptive, CIs): rho(D_name,R_lex) > rho(D_name,R_beh); rho(D_code,R_beh) > rho(D_code,R_lex); rho(D_desc,R_beh) > rho(D_desc,R_lex)

secondary_statistics: rank of g(dijkstra_unit) among NB5 (1 = nearest)
ratio g(dijkstra_unit)/median(g NB5) with bootstrap 95% CI

named_outcomes.CONFIRMED: P2, P3, P4 and P6 hold
named_outcomes.ROBUST-OPPOSITE: OPPOSITE on both M-code and M-desc
named_outcomes.MIXED: M-code and M-desc disagree, or a verdict changes between k 10 and 15, or SOURCE-SENSITIVE
named_outcomes.NAMES-ONLY: P3 and P4 hold but M-code and M-desc read MIDDLE or NEITHER
named_outcomes.UNTESTABLE: a gate fails as stated in the fallbacks

mcode_robustness: M-code verdict is ROBUST only if the source-homogeneous M32 frame gives the same class(dijkstra_unit); otherwise SOURCE-SENSITIVE

gates.G-repro: P1 (>= 0.95; 0.85-0.95 proceed with new states and report; < 0.85 deviation)
gates.G-name: >= 16/20 Qwen3-32B namings per description (T 1.0, top_p 1.0, thinking off)
gates.G-scrub: no alias match; ast.dump equal modulo names (docstrings removed); both hidden suites pass; expansion sequences on the 40 probe grids identical; labeller label unchanged
gates.G-tracer: every T1 reference shows its algorithm's properties on the probe grids
gates.G-place: leave-one-out placement accuracy >= 0.70 on the M-code frame

definitions.L1: number of banned algorithms b whose alias_regex([b]) matches the alias string
definitions.L2: max over banned aliases of character-3-gram Jaccard (lowercased)
definitions.L3: max over banned aliases of Qwen3 token-type Jaccard
definitions.R_lex: 1 - mean over alias pairs of character-3-gram Jaccard (10x10)
definitions.D_overlap: max content-word Jaccard (stoplist, plural stripping) with the 15 banned descriptions
definitions.d_beh: d_order + 0.5 * d_DS; d_order = 1 - mean over 40 probe grids of J*(1+tau_b)/2 (J = Jaccard of expanded-cell sets, tau_b over ranks of common cells, 0 if < 3); d_DS = Hamming/6 over (fifo, lifo_or_recursion, heap, two_frontiers, restarts, heuristic_key); lambda 0 and 1 reported
definitions.R_surface: 1 - mean Jaccard of identifier-normalised AST 4-gram shingles between PRIMARY program sets
definitions.R_len: absolute difference of mean stimulus token length
definitions.out_of_sample: d(x,j) = min over x's k nearest frame points i of (||x-i|| + geo(i,j)); frozen graph

readouts.S-mean: mean over the SPEC tokens of the block output (iteration 8)
readouts.R1g: R1 without tokens whose norm > 10x the sequence median
readouts.R2: token after the earliest popleft/pop/heappop/get call in the code (AST); fallback: first token of the neighbour-loop body / first body statement of solve

definitions.block_rule: iteration-8 layer_curve: standardise, PCA 64, logistic C=1, GroupKFold 10, balanced accuracy, ties within 0.01 or all-ceiling -> block nearest depth 0.5; block 31 (32B) and the depth-0.5 block (8B) always reported
definitions.k_rule: verdict at k 15 (iteration 8 primary) and k 10; k 5 reported
definitions.classes: EDGE g < median, MIDDLE g == median, OPPOSITE g > median over NB5 (iteration 8)
definitions.landing: iteration-8 landing(): nulls U, F, P (120 permutations), C; verdict EDGE iff p_edge(U) < .05 and p_edge(F) < .05 and > 50% survivors EDGE; OPPOSITE mirrored; else NEITHER
definitions.rsa: Spearman over 45 pairs, exact Mantel p over all 10! label permutations
drop_order: robustness grid reduced to block 31 + L*

correlational_statement: geometry is correlational; no causal claim (iteration-7 in-manifold pushes moved 0/300)
